api/payments-api.md.text:
# Payments API

REQ-1 - Create Refund
POST /refunds creates a refund for a captured payment and returns 201 with the refund id.
The refund amount cannot exceed the captured amount; otherwise the API returns 422 with code AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE.

REQ-2 - Idempotent Requests
A request repeating an Idempotency-Key already used by the same client returns the original response without creating a second refund.

REQ-3 - Refund Settlement
A created refund is settled through the acquirer and its status becomes SETTLED when the acquirer confirms.

REQ-4 - Client Isolation
A client can only read refunds it created; reading another client's refund returns 404.

invariants: refund amount never exceeds the captured amount
permissions: clients read only their own refunds

requirements.source_statement: POST /refunds creates a refund for a captured payment; amounts above the capture return 422.
A repeated Idempotency-Key returns the original response without a second refund.
Refunds are settled through the acquirer and become SETTLED on confirmation.
Clients read only their own refunds; others return 404.

claims.text: POST /refunds for a captured payment returns 201 with the refund id.
A refund above the captured amount returns 422 with code AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE.
Repeating an Idempotency-Key returns the original response and no second refund exists.
A refund status becomes SETTLED when the acquirer confirms it.
Reading a refund created by another client returns 404.

questions.question: Is there a documented maximum number of refunds per payment?
questions.reason: The implementation rejects a fourth refund with 409 but the specification is silent.

findings.statement: The implementation rejects a fourth refund with 409 TOO_MANY_REFUNDS, a limit the specification does not define.
